(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers, including a first layer and a second layer; a first adhesive layer on the first layer; a second adhesive layer on the second layer; and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer located in registration with the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a honeycomb structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the medial section includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 281, further including a plurality of cutting segments located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.
